title: The physical world is a compendium of bits of information

statements.text: Each answer injects one bit of information into the quantum state of the universe, which carries the informational content of each mental event into the future and controls the propensities for later events. The physical world is a stored compendium of locally efficacious bits of information.

sources.quote: Thus each answer, Yes or No, injects one “bit” of information into the quantum universe.
as an atomistically stored compendium of locally efficacious bits of information
